status: Qualified exterior reference for the next north projection study; no reconstruction accepted

source.use: Research only; source pixels remain local and are not used as textures.

observations: At 26 seconds a small dark glazed-looking projection is visible at the left side of the lower Atom-Ei, with a roof distinct from the adjoining pale canopy.
The main lower ring has warm brick, pale vertical divisions and an upper glazed band.
The 30-second and closing aerial views mainly expose the MLZ buildings and do not establish finer entrance details.
registrationInference: The 26-second view appears to be from the north side, with the MLZ block in front/right of the Atom-Ei and the reactor complex to the left. The small projection is therefore a candidate reference for north body 108698323. This is not a calibrated match; verify its roof outline against the survey before reconstruction.
limitations: The dark facade occupies too few source pixels to resolve individual mullions, door leaves or material finish confidently.
The public interactive panorama opens on interiors and did not provide a useful exterior registration.
nextActions: Register the measured nine-triangle roof and footprint against the 26-second exterior frame and orthophoto.
